status: shipped, animated (greybox clips in ATL and X Games style, not reviewed by skaters)
credits: The author generated this model with Tripo from original concept art. No third-party art is in it.

steps.tool: Tripo Studio web UI (studio.tripo3d.ai), Image to 3D
steps.settings: HD Model, AI model H3.1 - Best Quality, Generate in Parts off, 8K Texture off
Quad topology, Smart Mesh on, polygon count 9000
steps.result: 9,558 quad faces, 8,960 vertices (17,896 triangles in the GLB)

steps.settings: Rigging type Humanoid, skeleton preset Mixamo
steps.result: 65 joints with the mixamorig: prefix, one skin, no animations

steps.settings: Format GLB, texture resolution 4k, Export Skeleton on

steps.tool: Blender 5.2.2 LTS through the Blender MCP (blender-mcp add-on, port 9876)
actions: Imported assets/skaters/nia/raw/nia-tripo.glb with the glTF importer.
Removed the Tripo empties (Node_0, node_0, RootNode) and kept the world transform of the armature.
Scaled the armature and the mesh by 1.7384 (0.978 m to 1.700 m) and applied the location, the rotation, and the scale.
Checked that the wheels touch z = 0 and that the model faces -Y in Blender (+Z in glTF).
Kept the Mixamo rig (65 mixamorig: joints) and the skin weights. The mesh was not decimated, because it had 17,896 triangles.
Resized the textures: base color 4096 to 2048, normal 2048 to 1024, metallic-roughness 2048 PNG to 1024 JPEG. All JPEG, quality 88.
Set the specular tint to white, so that the exporter writes no KHR_materials_specular. KHR_materials_volume and FB_ngon_encoding are not written.
Exported a GLB with Draco (level 6; quantization: position 14, normal 10, texcoord 12, generic 12), no animations.
steps.result: assets/skaters/nia/skater.glb, 2,123,152 bytes, 17,896 triangles, 1 skinned mesh, 65 joints, 1.700 m tall, extensions: KHR_draco_mesh_compression only
local_files_not_in_git: assets/skaters/nia/raw/nia-nodraco.glb (the same export without Draco, 3,732,876 bytes, for Cascadeur)

steps.tool: Blender 5.2.2 LTS through the Blender MCP, script scripts/blender/nia_clips.py
actions: Keyed 15 clips by hand in Python on the Mixamo rig: idle, push, coast, carve_left, carve_right, jump, air_trick_1 (grab), air_trick_2 (split), grind, manual, bail, dance_1 to dance_4.
Leg IK (pole angle 0) and a copy-rotation on each foot held the wheels on the ground. Each clip was baked to bone keys at 30 fps, and the IK helpers were removed.
Removed the curves that stay at the rest pose (8,945 curves). Set the baked keys to linear.
Exported with Draco and the same mesh and texture settings as M1-01, with all actions as glTF animations.
steps.result: assets/skaters/nia/skater.glb, 2,290,112 bytes, 17,896 triangles, 65 joints, 15 animations (13 to 21 channels each)
local_files_not_in_git: assets/skaters/nia/raw/nia-nodraco.glb (the animated export without Draco, 3,899,844 bytes)

steps.tool: Blender 5.2.2 LTS through the Blender MCP, script scripts/blender/nia_clips.py
steps.issue: M1-02 (#12), second pass after the user playtest
actions: Replaced the clip set with 20 clips in Atlanta rink style (free skate) and X Games style (rails and air). The sources are in docs/characters/skate-style-references.md.

Free skate: idle, push (ATL stride), coast, ride_back, carve_left, carve_right (Cross Step). Air: jump, land, air_mute, air_japan, air_liukang. Rails: grind_frontside, grind_soul, grind_unity, manual. Fail: bail. Style: dance_prep, dance_crisscross, dance_spin, dance_sitspin.
Keyed the groove clips at 24 frames per beat. Turned the knee pole targets with the hips for the rail stances.
Removed the curves that stay at the rest pose (11,665 curves). Exported with the same Draco, mesh, and texture settings.
steps.result: assets/skaters/nia/skater.glb, 2,427,940 bytes, 17,896 triangles, 65 joints, 20 animations (18 to 24 channels each)

steps.step: Third pass: the push stroke goes diagonally out and back, and the arms swing in a sine wave with shoulder turn. The other 19 clips are rebaked with no change.

Fourth pass: a new idle (hand on the hip, toe tap), and four new dances (Bankhead Bounce, Walk It Out, Swag Surf, Snap Lean). The Prep, crisscross, and the spins are retimed to whole beats. 24 animations.
Fifth pass: the coast is now the ATL ride glide, one bar, with a scissor stance, a dip on each beat, and shoulder rolls.

steps.command: npx @gltf-transform/cli@4.1.1 resize assets/skaters/nia/skater.glb assets/skaters/nia/skater-1024.glb --width 1024 --height 1024 && npx @gltf-transform/cli@4.1.1 draco assets/skaters/nia/skater-1024.glb assets/skaters/nia/skater-1024.glb --quantize-position 14 --quantize-normal 10 --quantize-texcoord 12 --quantize-generic 12
actions: Made the phone variant (#74): the base color texture from 2048 px to 1024 px. The normal and roughness maps were already 1024 px; the tool encoded them again as JPEG.
The resize decoded the Draco meshes. The draco command compressed them again with the M1-01 quantization (position 14, normal 10, texcoord 12, generic 12). It also welded identical vertices.
No new generation and no credits. The mesh, the rig, the joint names, and the 24 clips are the same as skater.glb (src/render/skater-model.test.js checks them).
steps.result: assets/skaters/nia/skater-1024.glb, 1,598,396 bytes (skater.glb is 2,735,736 bytes), the same triangles, joints, and clips

steps.tool: scripts/skater-lod.mjs (meshoptimizer 1.3.0 simplifyWithAttributes, @gltf-transform/core, functions, and extensions 4.5.1, draco3dgltf 1.5.9)
steps.settings: mode color; target 3000 triangles; target error 0.05; attribute weights normal 0.25, color 1; flags Prune; vertex color = mean of the 9 x 9 texels around the UV, in linear color; Draco sequential, quantization position 14, normal 10, color 8, generic 12
actions: Welded the identical vertices. Baked the base color texture into vertex colors (COLOR_0) and removed the UVs.
Welded the vertices at one position into one vertex (mean normal, mean color, the skin of the first vertex). All vertices at one position had the same skin.
Simplified the mesh with meshoptimizer. The simplifier only removes vertices, so each vertex keeps its position and its JOINTS_0 and WEIGHTS_0 from the source.
Kept the skin: the 65 mixamorig: joints, in the same order, with the same inverse bind matrices. Removed the clips and the textures (the game uses the clips of skater.glb).
steps.result: assets/skaters/nia/skater-lod1.glb, 60,356 bytes, 2,997 triangles, 1,502 vertices, 65 joints, no animations, no textures
